title: Free Higher Education (FHE) under RA 10931
description: Automatic tuition and other school fees subsidy for eligible students enrolled in SUCs and CHED-recognized LUCs under the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (RA 10931). Distinct from TES cash grant.
benefit_summary: Free tuition and other school fees at SUCs/LUCs for eligible undergraduates per RA 10931 implementing guidelines
evidence_snippet: Programs under R.A. 10931 include Free Higher Education alongside TES and Student Loan Program on official UniFAST site

title: Student Loan Program for Tertiary Education – Short Term (SLPTE-ST)
description: Short-term student loan for tertiary education expenses at SUCs, CHED-recognized LUCs, and private HEIs. UniFAST materials note applications may be suspended while guidelines are under review.
benefit_summary: Short-term loan covering tuition and education-related expenses; repayment terms per UniFAST MC guidelines
evidence_snippet: Applications are suspended while the SLP guidelines are under review (UAQTEA 2025 trifold)
